reviews.comment: He was a guest lecturer for the ChemE PChem class. Best lecture to date in the entire course. It wasn't even that good, our current professor is just so bad anything will outshine him.

don't take him. he seems passionate about the material but is a very poor communicator. could not figure out how to turn up the microphone in a class of 300+. sometimes flat out doesnt know the answer to questions over the material, then does an iclicker over it. i enjoyed this class because i had friends in it, but was very difficult to succeed.
Very bad, His lectures were boring and didn't talk about the topics that were on the test.

Dr. Son was ok, he wasn't really good at lectures and skipped through a lot of things without doing practice on certain concepts. Did lecture quizzes, gave a decent bit of extra credit, so those were good grade boosters. I'd recommend other professors just because they go into depth on the concepts compared to Dr. Son.

Professor Son is a cool guy but he SUCKS at teaching. I couldn't tell what was and wasn't important in the lectures due to his monotonous tone. I know that there are other reviews that say everyone loved him, but we all clapped ironically. The midterm and final make up 45% of the grade, the quizzes are hard so study for them. Attendance counts.

I would not recommend taking Dr. Son as a professor. There are better chemistry 107 professors. His lectures were not helpful and hard to sit through, and he would also skip through practice problems. The problems he did solve in the powerpoints during class were not explained well. Quizzes are hard, prepare to teach yourself.
Was probably a decent teacher but it was hard to pay attention and I just ended up learning everything from the internet and only showed up for the mandatory iclickers.

There were 6 quizzes and 2 tests that were all online. These tests were not very hard, but you should definitely study. The grading criteria for iClicker and homework is lenient, but you will still need to attend most lectures to receive the max iClicker points. He has an accent, but you can still understand 99% of his lectures.

He turned out the be a great professor. Everyone clapped for him when he walked in every class. His lectures are very helpful if you follow along, take notes, and do the practice problems with him. Make sure to do the iclicker. Homework is a lot but its really helpful for the biweekly quizzes (which are tough), midterm, and the final.
Dr. Son is a great man and a passionate chemist, he is not the best teacher but had a very fun class. Would not take again, but everyone loves Dr. Son

Dr. Son, while a good person, did not teach the class very well. It seemed like Dr. Son would try his best to teach us the content we needed, but he wasn't able to actually teach that knowledge to us very well. I will not be taking any more of his classes and I would avoid him for CHEM-107 if you can.
Hes such a cool guy! every lecture when he would walk in the room the entire class would start clapping and applauding him. the class was hard but he did his best and made class enjoyable.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I would avoid taking Dr. Son if you can. He barely teaches the content, and sometimes admits that he doesn't know it, and then makes us do an iClicker question over the same content. I haven't learned anything in a single lecture, and have been teaching myself the content. The only reason I gave a 2/5 is because he's at least passionate about Chem.

Don't take Dong if you want someone to teach you the material. There are iclicker questions every class, so there's not really an option to skip. Didn't learn a single thing from the lectures, Khan Academy videos are the only reason I passed this class.

Do anything in your power to not get him, he doesn't explain anything about what'll be on the quiz and the exam except for obviously what the units are, goes over practice problems like we are the smartest chem people ever, and makes units way harder than they actually are, over explains and overcomplicates things which makes it confusing anduseles

This was for Chem 103 actually, and he does not teach at all in class, gets off topic a lot and instead of explaining step by step how he gets numbers on certain problems, skips and says "It's very simple" and once you ask him a question, he'll look at you and only explain quickly and not step by step, making it even more confusing.

Dr. Son, in my honest opinion, was the worst professor I have taken at A&M. He provided minimal effort in teaching the class. Using exclusively textbook made homework sets as example problems, would not inform us clear of conventions for solving problems, blame us for failing, and not alter his style after the class fails. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is the hardest class I have ever taken at A&M just based on material, but Dr son really tries his best to explain it well. He is understanding if you ask for help in his office. He does expect a lot of effort from you though. Study hard, do practice problems and read the text book!! In class problems are very helpful. POP QUIZZES count a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader
